newsitem.title: USA: LG&E Energy completes Argentina deal.
newsitem.headline: LG&E Energy completes Argentina deal.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp said Thursday it has completed the acquisition for $140 million of interests in two Argentine natural gas distribution companies.
Closing of the transaction gives LG&E controlling interest in and management of Distribuidora de Gas del Centro and a minority interest in Distribuidora de Gas Cuyana, it said.
The company said its global venture unit, LG&E International, bought the interests from Sideco Americana, S.A., an Argentine company that held stakes in both companies.

LG&E said Centro and Cuyana have combined sales of over $270 million annually and more than $400 million in total assets. Both companies were formerly part of the government-owned Gas del Estado, which was privatized in 1992, it said.
